request.action_description: One complete standing martial arts SIDE KICK toward screen left, then return to the original fighting guard. Start with both feet grounded and hands raised. Chamber the kicking knee high across the body, pivot the supporting foot and turn hips sideways. Drive the HEEL horizontally left at an opponent's WAIST height, fully straightening the kicking knee so hip, knee, and heel form one long nearly horizontal line. Hold the clearly extended straight leg briefly. Lean torso slightly right for balance while the support foot stays planted. Recoil the knee back into chamber, lower the foot, and return smoothly to the exact starting guard. Entire body and extended foot stay visible, stationary camera, no travel. No bent-knee front kick, no low kick, no jump, no spinning, no extra limbs. Preserve consistent body proportions, glasses, beard, black shirt, dark jeans, sneakers and forearm tattoo.
